refs.income_per_household_annual: atles-renda-bruta-per-llar (2023), gross (not disposable) taxable income per household, household-weighted mean of census-section values (weights from pad_dom_mdbas_n-persones 2025)
refs.owner_share: habit-ppal-segons-regim-tin (2011), share of main dwellings owned outright, with a mortgage, or by inheritance/donation (rented + ceded-free/cheap + other = non-owner); barri rows summed to district. Most recent district-resolution tenure table found - see SOURCES.md for why the 2021 census and 2017 Enquesta Sociodemografica were not usable here.
refs.avg_household_size: pad_dom_mdbas_n-persones (2025), mean of N_PERSONES_AGG (household-size band, capped at 9=9+) weighted by household counts, by census section
refs.area_km2: derived: shoelace-formula area of the district polygon in its source UTM projection (from 20170706-districtes-barris 2017), same computation used for transit_score
refs.tourist_flats: habitatges-us-turistic (2026), count of licensed tourist-use dwellings (HUT) currently registered, by district
refs.car_ownership: derived from rebuts-quota-padro-vehicle-bcn (2026), 'Turismes' (cars) registered to an owner address in the district, divided by an assumed 1.2 cars per car-owning household (documented, undisclosed-at-district-resolution assumption - see SOURCES.md) and by total households (pad_dom_mdbas_n-persones 2025); capped at 0.98
refs.commute_mode_share: derived: city-wide all-trip-purpose modal split from EMEF 2024 (ATM, Informe especific Barcelona, section 3.1) adjusted per district with a damped elasticity (0.5) to that district's own transit_score (public-transport share) and car_ownership (car share), bike share held at the city figure, walk as residual - no district x mode x purpose table was machine-extractable; known to still understate Eixample's real active-mode share - see SOURCES.md
refs.households_with_children_share: pad_dom_mdbas_tipus-domicili (2025), share of households (TIPUS_DOMICILI categories 9-12, i.e. containing at least one person under 18) over all household-structure categories, by census section, summed to district

refs.age_distribution: derived from pad_mdbas_edat-q (2025) EDAT_Q five-year bands, 15-19 band split 60/40 between 0-17 and 18-34 assuming uniform ages within band
